breakdown.description: With R ∝ 1/α, increasing α lowers thermal-shock resistance rather than improving it.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly identifies that α appears in the denominator of R, making R inversely proportional to α. It explicitly states that increasing α decreases R (worsening thermal-shock resistance) and directly contradicts the original incorrect conclusion that 'increasing α improves thermal-shock resistance.'
